pendentes.alt: Sala clara com janelas abertas em paredes opostas, cortinas leves de linho balançando com a brisa e plantas no canto

Light oak floor, a low beige sofa, a woven jute rug and a large potted plant near the window. Soft morning daylight, green garden visible through both windows. Interior design photography, wide angle, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Parede de sala em tom quente com uma pintura abstrata emoldurada, iluminada de forma suave por um spot no teto

A discreet ceiling track spotlight casts a soft, even wash of warm light over the canvas. Below it, a low walnut sideboard with a ceramic vase. Evening ambience, interior design photography, eye level.

Architectural photography, three-quarter view, eye level.

Architectural photography from a slightly elevated angle, bright late-morning sunlight, crisp shadows.

Soft morning sunlight, a green plant in a ceramic pot in the background, shallow depth of field, editorial interior photography.

Warm wood cabinets, a large window with soft morning daylight, interior design photography, eye level, shallow depth of field.

Wide-angle architectural photography, eye level, natural light.

A permeable path of flat stones crosses the beds, with a small patch of lawn near a wooden bench. Soft morning sunlight, landscape architecture photography, slightly elevated angle.

Calm morning light, interior design photography, eye level.

pendentes.alt: Sala clara com janelas abertas, cortinas leves de linho se movendo com a brisa e plantas verdes perto da luz

Soft late-afternoon sunlight grazes the wood grain, showing a fresh protective finish. Clean modern architecture, architectural photography, low eye-level angle.

Three wooden bar stools on the far side, warm oak cabinetry along the back wall, and a soft gray sofa visible in the living area. Natural daylight from large windows, interior design photography, wide angle, eye level.

Built-in oak shelving with ceramic vases and plain boxes, a wool rug and a potted plant. Soft morning light, interior design photography, eye level.

Green lawns, a few small trees, clear blue sky, late afternoon sun. Architectural exterior photography, eye level, wide angle.

Soft morning daylight, shallow depth of field, interior design photography at eye level.

Warm afternoon light, white walls, interior design photography, eye level.

Soft neutral palette, a wool rug on a wooden floor, interior design photography, eye level.

Soft daylight from a side window, interior design photography, eye level, calm and clean.

Wall sconces illuminate the solid wood front door and the garage. The interior glows softly through large windows. Architectural photography, eye level, blue hour sky.

Mature trees and a neat green hedge in the background, soft morning light, wide-angle architectural photography at eye level.

Warm natural light, calm and spacious atmosphere, interior design photography, wide angle at eye level.
